name: getAttribute()
description: Reads the current value of a named attribute on an element.
returns: The attribute's string value, or null if the attribute doesn't exist.
notes: Always returns a string (or null) — even boolean-looking attributes like 'disabled' return an empty string when present.

name: setAttribute()
description: Sets the value of a named attribute on an element, creating it if it doesn't already exist.
parameters: name — the attribute name. value — coerced to a string.

name: removeAttribute()
description: Removes a named attribute from an element entirely.
parameters: name — the attribute name to remove.
notes: For boolean attributes like disabled or checked, removing the attribute is the correct way to turn it off rather than setting it to 'false'.

name: hasAttribute()
description: Checks whether an element currently has a given attribute, regardless of its value.
parameters: name — the attribute name to check.
returns: true if the attribute exists, false otherwise.

name: dataset
description: Provides convenient read/write access to an element's custom data-* attributes, exposed as camelCase properties.
parameters: Each data-my-value attribute maps to dataset.myValue.
returns: A DOMStringMap of the element's data-* attributes.
notes: All dataset values are strings; convert with Number()/JSON.parse() as needed.

name: Attributes vs properties
description: Attributes are the initial values defined in HTML markup and accessed as strings via getAttribute()/setAttribute(), while properties are the live JavaScript representation on the DOM object and can hold typed values (booleans, numbers, objects) that reflect the element's current state.
example:
input.getAttribute('value'); // original HTML value, unchanged by typing
input.value; // current live value as the user types
notes: For form controls especially, prefer the .value/.checked property over the attribute to read the current user-facing state.

name: toggleAttribute()
description: Adds an attribute if it's absent, or removes it if present; useful for boolean attributes like disabled or open.
parameters: name — attribute name. force — optional boolean to force add (true) or remove (false) instead of toggling.
returns: true if the attribute is present after the call, false otherwise.

name: attributes property
description: Returns a live collection of all attribute nodes currently set on an element, useful for iterating over every attribute generically.
returns: A live NamedNodeMap of Attr nodes.
